seo.title: All Things ODD — creative and cultural fields, business and society
seo.description: ODD builds events, spaces and projects that strengthen creative work and bring creative and cultural expertise closer to business and wider society.

hero.mosaicAlt: People, performances, talks and encounters from ODD in Helsinki.

opening.headline: ODD exists to build better conditions for creative work — and to bring creative and cultural fields closer to business and wider society.

whatOddIs.headline: Finland has no shortage of creative talent — what's missing is what gets built around it.
whatOddIs.body:
Creative work is still rebuilt from scratch: project by project, production by production, funding cycle by funding cycle.

At the same time, the people shaping culture and the people shaping business, institutions and public life spend surprisingly little time in the same room.

ODD works on both. More continuity around creative work — and more situations where different kinds of expertise actually meet.

twoWaysIn.intro: ODD has different doors, depending on why you are here.

creative.lede: Work, show and find your people.
creative.body: Use ODDspace as a place to keep working. Bring something of your own to ODDfest. Join the parts of ODD that are useful to your practice — without having to become part of a single scene or organisation.

business.lede: Get closer to creative expertise and the people behind it.
business.body: Come to ODDference, build a partnership, or bring us a question or project that needs a different mix of people around it.

proof.reportNote: The 2025 report covers ODDfest 2025 alone. The figures above are cumulative across everything ODD has run since.

proofIntro.headline: In less than two years, ODD has already brought thousands of people, collaborators and organisations into the same orbit.
proofIntro.body: More than 5,000 people have taken part. We have worked with 500+ collaborators and 100+ partners — and channelled more than €400,000 directly into the creative and cultural industries.

platforms.meta: Across Helsinki · Made by its hosts
platforms.title: ODDfest
platforms.body: Helsinki's creative week, made by the people taking part. Hosts make and produce their own programme; ODD brings it together into one shared week.

platforms.title: ODDference
platforms.body: A professional event built around one question: what can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise?

platforms.title: ODDspace
platforms.body: A place to work, meet, record, host things and keep projects moving — with different creative practices under the same roof.

workWithOdd.title: Work with ODD
workWithOdd.body: Bring us a question, brief, event or partnership idea. We'll work out what it actually needs.

participateTitle: The way in is by doing.
